notes.subject: ספקם
notes.rationale: Clap/strike: 'he strikes them' (KJV/BSB) vs 'he claps his hands at them' (gesture of derision, ylt-style) — root means clapping.

notes.subject: bjalo ka basebe
notes.rationale: תחת רשעים could also read 'in place of the wicked' (under/beneath), but 'as wicked' matches most versions.

notes.subject: תחת
notes.rationale: Root usually means 'underneath'; here adverbial 'as/instead of' — the spatial picture is lost in Sepedi.

translation: Bjalo ka basebe o ba betša, ka lefelong leo ba le bonago.
